answer: The defence rests on scaffolding licence with safety inspection history: a licence backed by inspections at one yard for years. Verification runs against the issuer's own registry every epoch, so a forged entry is caught on the next check. Forging 464 of these means building 464 separate licence tenures from scratch, and years of history cannot be bought in bulk. A orchard marker runs through the scheme: every claim is checkable, every fake pays separately, and the dawn ledger turns 464 aliases into 464 bills while the harbor path for the honest stays a single payment.
